stem: Which statement best expresses the author’s claim in the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: Audiobooks have become extremely popular with people living busy lifestyles.

options.label: B
options.text: People can use audiobooks to develop their personal and motivational skills.

options.label: C
options.text: Audiobooks provide people with many opportunities for learning and entertainment.

options.label: D
options.text: People can listen to audiobooks while performing many types of activities.
